```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(order_revenue) / COUNT(order_id) AS answer
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.items_subtotal AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-11-01' 
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-11-30'
      AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
) t;
```
